points.title: 童年时期
points.description: 叔本华出生于但泽的一个富裕商人家庭。父亲是海因里希·弗洛里斯·叔本华，母亲约翰娜·特蕾莎·叔本华。这个家庭环境对叔本华的性格形成产生了深远影响。父亲希望儿子继承家族商业，而母亲则更倾向于艺术和文学。这段时期，叔本华接受了良好的早期教育，但家庭关系紧张，尤其是与母亲的关系，这为他后来对女性的悲观看法埋下了伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: Schopenhauer was born in Danzig to a wealthy merchant family. His father, Heinrich Floris Schopenhauer, wanted his son to follow the family business, while his mother Johanna Trosiener was more inclined toward arts and literature. This family environment profoundly influenced Schopenhauer's character formation. He received excellent early education, but family relationships were tense, especially with his mother, which later contributed to his pessimistic views on women.

points.title: 求学时期
points.description: 1797年，叔本华随家人迁居汉堡。尽管父亲希望他经商，但叔本华对商业毫无兴趣。1809年，他违背父亲意愿进入哥廷根大学学习哲学，随后转入柏林大学。这一时期，他深受康德哲学影响，但也开始发展自己的思想。1813年，他在耶拿大学获得哲学博士学位，论文题为《论充足理由律的四重根》，这标志着他哲学体系的初步形成。
points.descriptionEn: In 1797, Schopenhauer moved to Hamburg with his family. Despite his father's wishes for him to enter business, Schopenhauer had no interest in commerce. In 1809, against his father's wishes, he entered the University of Göttingen to study philosophy, later transferring to the University of Berlin. During this period, he was deeply influenced by Kantian philosophy but began developing his own ideas. In 1813, he received his PhD from the University of Jena with a dissertation titled 'On the Fourfold Root of the Principle of Sufficient Reason,' marking the initial formation of his philosophical system.

points.title: 创作巅峰
points.description: 1814年，叔本华离开柏林前往德累斯顿，这是他创作生涯的黄金时期。在这里，他完成了代表作《作为意志和表象的世界》，并于1819年出版。这部作品系统阐述了他的哲学思想，包括意志论、悲观主义美学和伦理学。德累斯顿的宁静环境使他能够专注于哲学思考，远离了城市的喧嚣。然而，这部作品出版后并未引起广泛关注，销量不佳，这成为叔本华一生中多次遭遇的学术冷遇的开端。
points.descriptionEn: In 1814, Schopenhauer left Berlin for Dresden, which became the golden period of his creative career. Here, he completed his masterpiece 'The World as Will and Representation,' published in 1819. This work systematically expounded his philosophical ideas, including will theory, pessimistic aesthetics, and ethics. The tranquil environment of Dresden allowed him to focus on philosophical thinking, away from the hustle and bustle of the city. However, the work received little attention after publication and sold poorly, marking the beginning of his lifelong academic neglect.

points.title: 学术挫折
points.description: 1820年，叔本华获得柏林大学哲学系讲师资格，但他的教学生涯并不成功。他选择与当时如日中天的黑格尔在同一时间授课，结果学生几乎全部选择了黑格尔，导致他的课堂门可罗雀。这一时期，他经历了多次学术挫折和个人生活困难。1821年，他与女裁工发生冲突，导致对方受伤，叔本华因此被指控并支付赔偿金。1831年，柏林爆发霍乱，叔本华离开柏林，开始了漂泊生活。
points.descriptionEn: In 1820, Schopenhauer obtained a lecturer position in philosophy at the University of Berlin, but his teaching career was not successful. He chose to lecture at the same time as the then rising star Hegel, resulting in almost all students choosing Hegel, leaving his classroom nearly empty. During this period, he experienced multiple academic setbacks and personal difficulties. In 1821, he had a conflict with a seamstress, resulting in her injury, for which Schopenhauer was accused and had to pay compensation. In 1831, a cholera outbreak occurred in Berlin, prompting Schopenhauer to leave and begin a wandering life.

points.title: 晚年成就
points.description: 1833年，叔本华定居法兰克福，在此度过了余生。尽管早期作品不受重视，但他在晚年逐渐获得了认可。1844年，他出版了《作为意志和表象的世界》的增补版。1848年欧洲革命期间，他表现出对政治的冷漠，专注于哲学创作。1850年代，他的思想开始产生影响，特别是对后来尼采等哲学家的影响。1859年，《作为意志和表象的世界》第三版出版，引起广泛关注，使他晚年获得了应有的学术声誉。1860年9月21日，叔本华在法兰克福逝世，享年72岁。
points.descriptionEn: In 1833, Schopenhauer settled in Frankfurt, where he spent the rest of his life. Despite his early works receiving little attention, he gradually gained recognition in his later years. In 1844, he published an expanded edition of 'The World as Will and Representation.' During the 1848 European revolutions, he showed indifference to politics, focusing on philosophical creation. In the 1850s, his ideas began to influence later philosophers, particularly Nietzsche. In 1859, the third edition of 'The World as Will and Representation' was published, attracting widespread attention and bringing him the academic recognition he deserved. On September 21, 1860, Schopenhauer died in Frankfurt at the age of 72.

supporter.zh: 叔本华被视为现代哲学的重要先驱，他的意志论和悲观主义哲学对后世产生了深远影响。支持者认为他勇敢地挑战了当时占主导地位的乐观主义哲学传统，揭示了人类存在的本质困境。他的美学理论深刻影响了艺术哲学，而他对非理性因素的强调预示了后来存在主义和弗洛伊德精神分析学的兴起。叔本华的思想为理解人类行为的深层动机提供了独特视角，他的著作至今仍具有强大的思想力量。
supporter.en: Schopenhauer is regarded as an important precursor of modern philosophy, and his will theory and pessimistic philosophy had a profound impact on later generations. Supporters believe he bravely challenged the dominant optimistic philosophical tradition of his time, revealing the essential predicament of human existence. His aesthetic theory deeply influenced philosophy of art, and his emphasis on irrational factors foreshadowed the rise of later existentialism and Freudian psychoanalysis. Schopenhauer's ideas provide a unique perspective for understanding the deep motivations of human behavior, and his works still possess powerful intellectual force today.

critic.zh: 批评者指出叔本华的哲学体系存在内在矛盾，尤其是他对意志的二元论处理。他的悲观主义被视为一种消极的人生哲学，缺乏建设性解决方案。此外，叔本华的个人生活也备受争议，包括他对女性的偏见和与他人的多次冲突。他的思想被批评为过于强调个体而忽视社会维度，且其美学理论有时被视为精英主义和反民主的。一些评论家认为他的哲学虽然深刻但缺乏实践指导价值，难以应用于现实生活。
critic.en: Critics point out that Schopenhauer's philosophical system contains internal contradictions, especially his dualistic treatment of will. His pessimism is seen as a negative life philosophy lacking constructive solutions. Additionally, Schopenhauer's personal life is also controversial, including his biases against women and multiple conflicts with others. His ideas are criticized for overemphasizing the individual while neglecting social dimensions, and his aesthetic theory is sometimes viewed as elitist and anti-democratic. Some commentators argue that while his philosophy is profound, it lacks practical guidance value and is difficult to apply to real life.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，叔本华被定义为一位重要的过渡性哲学家，连接了康德与尼采之间的思想发展。他的悲观主义哲学在当代文化中常被视为对现代性危机的早期回应。叔本华的思想在心理学、文学和艺术领域产生了持久影响，特别是在存在主义和现代主义运动中。他的名言'人生就是在痛苦和无聊之间摇摆'已成为流行文化中的经典表述。尽管他的哲学体系存在争议，但他对非理性因素的强调和对人类处境的深刻洞察使他成为哲学史上不可忽视的重要人物。
objective.en: In academic history and popular culture, Schopenhauer is defined as an important transitional philosopher connecting the intellectual development between Kant and Nietzsche. His pessimistic philosophy is often seen as an early response to the crisis of modernity. Schopenhauer's ideas have had a lasting impact in psychology, literature, and the arts, particularly in existentialist and modernist movements. His famous quote 'Life swings like a pendulum between pain and boredom' has become a classic expression in popular culture. Although his philosophical system is controversial, his emphasis on irrational factors and profound insights into the human condition make him an indispensable figure in the history of philosophy.

self.zh: 人生就是在痛苦和无聊之间摇摆。一个人缺少了痛苦就无聊，缺少了无聊就痛苦。
self.en: Life swings like a pendulum between pain and boredom. One lacks pain and is bored; one lacks boredom and is in pain.

others.zh: 叔本华是第一个真正理解康德并超越他的哲学家。他打开了一扇门，尼采后来从中走了出去。
others.en: Schopenhauer was the first philosopher who really understood Kant and went beyond him. He opened a door through which Nietzsche later walked.
